composition_summary: Offline-design export only. The host supports class 22 (name/description/content) and class 21 (name/description/trigger/steps/prior_knowledge_content/intent_examples) but drops step_descriptions, variants and dependency_registry, so those three fields are omitted from the class-21 payload. The requested draft PythonCode UUID 84313e5b-c871-4f9e-9623-3986db9c5b2a is unapproved and unverified, so it is recorded in prior_knowledge_content as an unapproved draft dependency rather than used as a resolved reference. The single class-21 entry is a constructor draft with name recipe-fixed-ready-result, trigger null, steps [], dependency_registry null, one orchestrator component step including that UUID once, one variant with step_link 0:1-0:E, variable_patterns [], and ten unique intent examples. prior_knowledge_content states the unapproved draft dependency, that Q1 and human Q2 are required, that the subworkflow returns result only (not a posted user reply), and that the current Sempai sink cannot preserve this v3 draft. No submission, activation or approval occurred.
